Ride Ramara - Explore Ramara Trails Community Events

9:30 AM| Various

Grab your helmet and come explore Ramara's beautiful trails! 

Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just looking for a fun morning outdoors, Ride Ramara is organized by the Ramara Trails Committee and welcomes riders of all ages and skill levels.

Ride Dates:
July 22 – Lagoon City Trail
August 26 – Lovely Day Park Bayshore Trail
September 23 – Washago Trail

Rides begin at 9:30 a.m.
Register through Ramara Recreation: 705-325-3091

Bring your bike, invite a friend, and discover the beauty of Ramara - one trail at a time!

24 Sep
Meet Hospice Orillia Library Happenings

10:30 AM| 5482 Highway 12 S

Join us for an engaging discussion with Amanda and Ashley from Hospice Orillia, our community-based hospice that has been providing compassionate support through life's journey, loss, and grief since 1989. 

Learn about the free practical, emotional, and spiritual support available to individuals living with a life-limiting illness, as well as their families and caregivers. You'll also discover the many rewarding volunteer opportunities that help make Hospice Orillia's work possible.

3 Oct
Udney Music Fest Community Events

5:00 PM| 2347 Concession Rd. 10

Get ready for another night of live music in Udney! The Township of Ramara’s Udney Community Centre Board is bringing Udney Music Fest back for a second year, with an evening of music, food and community fun.

Taking place Saturday, Oct. 3, 2026, from 5 to 11 p.m. at the Udney Community Centre (2347 Concession Rd. 10), this year’s event will feature four bands and five performances as local musicians take the stage for “One Night in Udney.”

This year’s entertainment lineup includes featured performer Ty Wilson, a special appearance by the Tommy Banjo Band, Mike Church from Gravenhurst, and an encore performance by Bill Nadeau & the 21st Century Binary Backup Band.

Tickets are $20 for adults, $10 for children ages six to 17, and free for children five and under.

To purchase tickets or for more information, contact June at 249-385-6834.

For more information about Udney Fest, please contact the Udney Community Centre Board at udney.community.centre@gmail.com.

8 Oct
Keeping Ourselves Safe as We Age: Fraud Awareness and Prevention Library Happenings

10:30 AM| 5482 Highway 12 S

In Person with Virtual Presenter / Watch Virtually from Home 

This presentation explains what a scam is and tactics used to take advantage of older adults. Case examples illustrate the types of scams prevalent in society and how seniors can be vulnerable to this form of financial abuse. Cautions of Do’s and Don’ts are listed and important steps to protect from frauds and scams.

This presentation is brought to you by Elder Abuse Prevention Ontario.

The 2026 Municipal and School Board Election is October 26

The Township of Ramara's 2026 Municipal and School Board Election will be held on Monday, October 26, 2026, with online and telephone voting opening on October 8, 2026. Are you Vote Ready? Make sure you’re on the voters’ list, learn how to vote and view the certified list of candidates at ramara.ca/election.

Am I on the Voters’ List?

Check your information and make sure you’re ready to vote. 

When can I vote?

Voting opens October 8 and continues through October 26. 

How can I vote?

Online, by telephone or at an in-person voting opportunity. 

Who is running?

Find out who is running in the 2026 Municipal and School Board Election.
